name: council-of-elrond
description: A council that second-guesses risky tool calls before they run: Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas and Gimli review, Gollum guards secrets, and what they cannot settle comes to you as a loot roll.

model.title: Reviewer model
model.description: The model the council members review with.

shadowMode.title: Shadow mode
shadowMode.description: The council reviews and logs but never refuses. Block rules and the secrets scan still hold. Good for the first days.

councilPattern.title: Extra council pattern
councilPattern.description: A regular expression; a shell command it matches goes to the council. Example: \bmake\s+deploy\b

blockPattern.title: Extra block pattern
blockPattern.description: A regular expression; a shell command it matches is refused outright.
